title: Bach — Invention 8 in F, BWV 779

reference.license: Public Domain (Mutopia 2008/06/15-61, Allen Garvin after Bach-Gesellschaft). reference.sha256 pins the bare Mutopia .mid at reference.url (fetch copies it into the midi dir; there is no archive).

editionNotes: 3/4, F major (expectedFifths -1). 34 bars, no repeats, no ornament signs, no fermatas — the cleanest entry in the suite and the control for 'does the harness agree with itself when nothing is hard'.
No printed metronome mark; the \midi block asks for 90 to the quarter. expectedTempo is a band around it, and tempoInRange is a diagnostic.
pdf.sha256 pins the Mutopia letter PDF (2 pages). Do not embed document UUIDs.
